column1: 2.2.2.3 BB & NB RX (LB2-MB). Broadband and Narrow Band Receiver AHU is
configured to achieve a wide frequency coverage of 0.5-18 GHz with selectable modes
of operation for better interception ranges and higher accuracy of direction finding. BB &
NB Rx AHU is the integration of Broad Band and Narrow Band Receivers. It consists of 2.2
- 18 GHz Broad Band Receivers and 0.5-18 GHz Narrow Band Receivers which measures
Direction of Arrival (DOA) using 4 channel Base Line Interferometry (BLI) technique.
